description: RULED BY JORDAN 2026-10-09, in session, DIRECT: the project's Godot engine version is the 4.7 series. His words: "Actually, adopt Godot 4.7 now" -- given minutes after, and superseding, his instruction in the same session to note 4.6 as the resolution. The ruling names the minor series, not a patch release; the official archive (https://godotengine.org/download/archive/, read 2026-10-09) lists 4.7-stable (2026-06-18), 4.7.1 (2026-07-14) and 4.7.2 (2026-08-18, the latest 4.x stable then). It answers the one question v9 `_part5` section J.2 rank 2 (J-9) put: it settles the open engine-version item in `CLAUDE.md`'s preamble, which now points here. HISTORY, NOT A PIN: the 'Godot 4.6' he typed on 2026-09-01 and 2026-09-05 were organising instructions (v9 `_part7` GO-01 lists the events) and are superseded. NOT ANSWERED: D2, the tenth attribute's name (the count of ten is ruled, ED-IN-0193), which stays held. NOT DONE, and owed: (1) the machine-read owner for the version (GO-01 builds it; the ruling names no file), so until that lands THIS ROW is the one owner and no other file in this repository asserts a version; (2) `valoria-game`'s `project.godot` and CI pin were not read or changed -- GO-06, not checkable from this repository -- and are owed a move to this series; (3) `godot/godot_conversion_strategy_v1.md` stays PROPOSED and held: this ruling ratifies nothing in it. Recorded by the session that received the instruction; the plan's J-9 hold is cleared in the same commit.
